what: RLVR Design-1 loop validation: GRPO fine-tune Qwen3-8B (SFT-seed merged + fresh LoRA) against the verifiable kernel reward, temp 1.5, on the canonical compile corpus.

training.note: 75% of GRPO groups had zero advantage every step (easy all-8 + dead all-0); only ~25% frontier carried gradient. Most of the corpus gave GRPO nothing to learn, by construction.

checkpoint50_remeasure.read: Density dead-flat at 0.409 across all temps; ~54% of hard prompts still all-0 after SFT + 50 GRPO steps. Frontier count grows with temp (8->13) but total certified mass unchanged. 50 steps of LoRA-GRPO is a weak lever on the zero-probability dead tail.

verdict: Design-1 loop CLOSES and is measurable, but the lever is weak on the dead tail because Qwen3-8B already carries a fully-formed lambda function -- RLVR there redirects an existing capability rather than constructing one. This is the motivating CONTROL for the V15-clean pivot: move the reducer OUT of the learned model (freeze the routing topology = crystal lattice; replace reduce neurons with exact kernel calls; learn only the thin prose->LF front-end). See knowledge/explore/compiler-as-loss.md (s242 amendment).
